name: Ethan Wood
education: B.S. in Computer Science, Arizona State University
summary: DevOps engineer with 4 years of experience containerizing applications with Docker, running Kubernetes clusters, and automating infrastructure end-to-end with Terraform and GitHub Actions on Linux.
strengths: Full CI/CD ownership with GitHub Actions, from build to production rollout
Hands-on Docker and Kubernetes operations across staging and production
Infrastructure as code with Terraform covering AWS resources and cluster config
Comfortable administering Linux hosts, hardening images and debugging container runtimes
gaps: Limited multi-cloud exposure - most experience is on AWS

resumeText: Ethan Wood is a DevOps Engineer at Driftline Logistics where he owns the delivery pipeline built on GitHub Actions, containerizing services with Docker and running them on a Kubernetes cluster managed through Terraform. Previously at CoreStack Labs he automated AWS infrastructure, cut deploy times in half, and maintained a fleet of hardened Linux hosts. He is looking to grow deeper into platform and reliability work.
